flow_tuner_state_discovery.label: Flow mixes in more discoveries. This is a setting of your Deezer account, so it also applies in the Deezer app and on your other devices.

flow_tuner_state_default.label: Flow uses Deezer's default mix. This is a setting of your Deezer account, so it also applies in the Deezer app and on your other devices.

manifest.description: Stream Deezer’s full music catalogue in CD-quality (FLAC) audio.

errors.no_subscription: This Deezer account has no subscription that Music Assistant can stream from. Deezer Free accounts are not supported; check that the subscription on this specific account is still active.
errors.arl_rejected: Could not authenticate with Deezer using this ARL token. Try again and check that the token is current. See the Music Assistant log for details.
errors.gw_no_session: Deezer authenticated this account but could not establish a playback session. Try again. If the problem persists, see the Music Assistant log for details.
errors.auth_failed: Could not sign in to Deezer. See the Music Assistant log for the reason reported by Deezer.
